title: Flame spread.
officialText:
The flame spread index shall not exceed 75 where tested in accordance with ASTM E 84 or UL 723. The
smoke-developed index shall not be limited.
Exception: When the interior trim material has been tested as an interior finish in accordance with NFPA 286 and complies with
the acceptance criteria in Section 803.1.2.1 of this code, it shall not be required to be tested for flame spread index in accordance
with ASTM E 84 or UL 723.
SECTION BC 2605
